note: ART-005 / stage 3 T3.2: data-driven -ArtPreview board art. Zone palette and glyphs are keyed by zone KEY (never by board); lighting is one profile per board. Budget per profile: exactly 1 directional light with shadow + at most 6 point lights without shadows. Light sections are not gameplay zones: point lights sit at authored board-relative spots and a section (cells within half a light's radius) never coincides with one zone (tools/art/art_board_fixtures.py check: Jaccard < 0.5). Colors: zone 'color' is sRGB hex (FLinearColor(FColor) in code), light 'colorLinear' is linear RGB. Nothing here is artistically accepted.

zoneKeyline.note: W5b-R (2026-09-29, advisor decision D-4, docs/game-design/decisions/2026-09-29-board-readability-decisions.md): a dark keyline (#111317 = hud-style-tokens mark.keyline) 1.5 uu around every zone stroke and glyph, drawn UNDER the fill (strokes: keyline top z 0.33 < fill top 0.48; glyphs: keyline top 0.53 < fill top 0.58, glyphs above strokes). Strokes move inward (centre line 42 uu, clamped so that every stroke fill + keyline stays <= 45 uu from the cell centre, 1 uu inside the 46-uu slab edge; double: two 3-uu lines, 3-uu gap filled by the keylines). Glyph keylines are SM_ART005_ZoneGlyphKey_<Glyph> (the glyph cube pieces +1.5 uu, depth 0.3 uu, the glyph pivot); a missing mesh falls back to cube pieces (traced). Not counted in the legacy Cobble blueMarks/redMarks. -S08LegacyRender draws no keylines. Status: предложено.

marmoreal-night.source: ENV-MAPS night marble-palace garden (concept ENV-U8, scraped-data/derived/concepts/env-v1/marmoreal-v1.png); rev 9 = ENV-MAPS P2 night calibration (2026-10-01, editor -game -Bench K1 / K1x0.65 / K2x1.6, log C:/tmp/envmaps-research/p2/light): cool blue-grey moon key 3.5 lux from W-NW (rotation kept at the pinned (-55,30,0)), low cool sky 3.0, one broad cool-white moon pool (260 cd, 750 uu over the map centre, r 1250) that keeps the map brighter than its surroundings, night haze fog around the tray (start 2900 uu: the board stays out of it), map night grade on the M_MapBoard MID (mapGrade). The warm pools are the env layout lights (EnvLayouts/marmoreal.layout.json: 4 lanterns + portal glow OUTSIDE the map); profile + layout = 6 points

heroLight.note: ENV-MAPS P9b hero light (docs/art-pipeline/ENV-HERO-LIGHT.md, «Ревизия после ревью 2026-10-02», S08HeroLight.h): an ACCENT under the fixed night exposure, not a main light (P9: key 50 lux + rim 30 lux = ~23 x the moon, coaxial with the camera, the pedestal lit -> over-lit, flat, cream pedestals). Key from the moon side (camera azimuth + 60, 42 deg down), 7 lux = 2.0 x the profile's moon key, colour #D8E2FF (cool moon white: counters the warm pink cast the garden throws on the figures (gate D6)), specular 0.5, screen-space contact shadows 0.1 (no shadow map); rim low (22 deg) behind the figure, 3.5 lux = 0.5 x the key, specular 0.8; the pedestal unlit (litPedestal false); active x 1.15, breathing +-0.04. Gates D1-D6 / H2 measured with tools/art/render/hero_light_metrics.py. Status: предложено, измерено.

conceptPaste.note: ENV-U16 (VS-5 E1, EN-06 + EN-07, по делегированию): the painted backdrop of Marmoreal - the accepted clean plate x2 with the painted lanterns baked in (art/imagegen/env-u16-marmoreal-codex, cp_bake.py), the anim channels (flicker in sync with the 5 points, wind in the crowns, ground mist) on MI_ConceptPaste_Anim; the P5c layout lights hidden (5 own points + moon-pool = 6). ON by default since EN-13 (rev 23, VS-5 E3); rollback -NoConceptPaste / -ConceptPaste=0 / -EnvLayoutVariant=p5c = the 3D P5c surroundings with the T2b tray (ВР-56). Lights / wind / mist are the start values of EN-08 / EN-10 / EN-12 (they tune them). VS-5 E2 (по делегированию, live tune 2026-10-07): EN-08 lights and flicker kept (ВР-EN.14: the P5c values, the Sarpedon lantern flicker; D3 0.015 %, zones dE76 23.7); EN-10 wind ampPx 1.2 -> 0.5 (ВР-VS5-14: G7 of the x2 plate crowns 45 % -> ~20 %); EN-12 mist colorSrgb #0F1523 -> #2A3A58 and opacity 0.22 (ВР-VS5-15: the mask median gave dL* 0). Status: ENV-U16 закрыт - принято по делегированию (ВР-53, ВР-60); приёмка P5c от 2026-10-01 заменена решением пользователя 2026-10-04.
